definitions.cpu_ms_per_success: Total sampled-interval server process CPU, including failed/background work, divided by successful requests.
definitions.p99_range: Range of per-window percentiles; not pooled.
definitions.average_occupied_slots: Observed processing hold sums / 60 seconds, excluding observer callbacks.
definitions.driver_wait: Scheduled arrival until worker starts request: scheduler and bounded arrival queue.
definitions.request_time: Client request start through HTTP completion and validation; includes connection wait and network.
definitions.diagnosis_complete: All fixed windows and profiles collected; does not imply all loads accepted.

decision: Keep iterator reuse and bounded observability. No admission increase or retry. List 1200 and sync 420 remain unqualified. No single root cause proven for all transient bursts.
